lines.t: Ooooooo
Eat of me
Partake of my words and be filled
Breathe me in, that the song of the Lamb may dwell within you
For it is the knowledge of my love
The revelation of who I truly am
A song, a chorus
Soon to be a symphony
A great outpouring of revelation
To the praise of my glory
Beloved, it is also the music we share
Sweet melodies of grace and peace playing softly
Within your heart, each string plucked gently and surely
The sound of my love revealed in you
And through you
My spirit, my breath, my life
Given and received
Bearing much fruit in the beloved
Says the Lord
Says the Lord
Yahushua
